title: uniqueKeys reports each item whose key repeats an earlier one's, once, naming the first, at the key's cell or at the item, wherever its schema object applies to an array
notes: single holds a key repeated twice and one repeated once, every repeat reported naming the first item with its key; rows with no criterion, which take no part; and null repeated, a value equal to null. composite has a key of two pointers, located at the item, and items keyless for a missing part. numbers has 1.0, 1 and 10e-1, one value, and the string "1", another. rows is a CSV input, each finding at its cell's line and column with the first row's cell in related. items is a collection, each finding in its item's file. referenced reaches the keyword through $ref, conditional under then; scalar holds the keyword on schema objects that apply to an object and a number, which it never judges. The valid case holds distinct keys and keyless rows.
